motion_system: Light travels through acrylic ribs in fast procession intervals; etched punctures shimmer along the edges while slits open like narrow breaths.
color_drift: Pale ice white and mist blue above, sinking into electric cyan, deep pool blue, dark teal edges, warm grey scuffs, and muted charcoal scratches below.
glow_behavior: Frosted upper bloom diffuses across rib crests; lower glints concentrate on acrylic corners and embedded apertures.
